## GOVERNMENT OF ANDHRA PRADESH
ABSTRACT

YAT&C (Sports & Youth Services) Department – Sports Policy 2024-29 -
Implementation of three percent (3%) horizontal reservation to meritorious
sportspersons in direct recruitment across Government Departments, Local
Bodies, Public Sector Undertakings (PSUs), and Uniformed Services including
Police, Excise, and Forest Departments etc.– Revised Guidelines – Notification –
Orders- Issued.

## YOUTH ADVANCEMENT TOURISM & CULTURE (Sps & YS) DEPARTMENT

G.O.Ms.No.25

Dated: 15-05-2026
Read the following:-

1. G.O.Ms.No.74, YAT&C(Sports) Department, dt.09-08-2012.
2. G.O.Ms.No.8, YAT&C(Sports) Department, dt.23-11-2020.
3. G.O.Ms.No.18, YAT&C (Sports & YS) Department, dt:10-12-2024.
4. G.O.Ms.No. 4, YAT&C (Sports & YS) Department, Dated: 19-04-2025
5. G.O.Ms.No.23, YAT&C (Sports & YS) Department, dt:14-05-2026.
6. From the Secretary, Andhra Pradesh Public Service Commission,
Vijayawada e-file notings dated 14-05-2026 in computer no.3258041.
*****

## ORDER:

In the G.O. third read above, the Government of Andhra Pradesh issued the
Sports Policy 2024–29 with the objective of promoting sports development in the
State by creating world-class infrastructure, nurturing sporting talent, and
ensuring inclusive access to sports opportunities. The policy envisions positioning
“Swarna Andhra Pradesh” as the Nation’s sports capital and a global hub for sports
excellence and innovation by the year 2029.

2. The policy, inter alia, provides for a three percent (3%) horizontal
reservation in direct recruitment across Government Departments, Local Bodies,
Public Sector Undertakings (PSUs), and Uniformed Services, including Police,
Excise, and Forest Departments, for eligible meritorious sportspersons of Andhra
Pradesh. Accordingly, guidelines were issued in the G.O. fourth read above for
implementation of the said horizontal reservation.

3. During the course of implementation of G.O. fourth read above, certain
difficulties have arisen and several representations & grievances have also been
received from various sportspersons regarding the operational aspects of the said
G.O. In this context, Government vide G.O. 5ᵗʰ read above, have made
amendment to clause 6.1 of the Andhra Pradesh Sports Policy 2024-29 issued in
G.O.Ms.No.18, YAT&C (Sports & YS) Department, dt:10-12-2024 to that extent.
Consequent to the above, the guidelines issued for implementation of 3%
horizontal reservation to the meritorious sportspersons in G.O. fourth read above,
needs to be revised.

P.T.O

4.     Accordingly, Government, after careful examination of the matter, and in
supersession of the orders issued in reference 4ᵗʰ read above, hereby issue revised
guidelines in the Notification for the implementation of three percent (3%)
horizontal reservation for meritorious sportspersons in direct recruitment across
Government Departments, Local Bodies, PSUs, and Uniform Services including
Police, Excise, and Forest Departments etc., who qualify in the prescribed
Recruitment Examinations conducted by recruiting agencies.

5. The following Notification shall be published in the Andhra Pradesh Gazette.

## NOTIFICATION

In pursuance of the Sports Policy 2024-29 issued in G.O.Ms.No.18, YAT&C
(Sps & YS) Dept., dated 10-12-2024 and in pursuance of the amendment orders
issued to the Andhra Pradesh Sports Policy 2024-29 in G.O.Ms.No.23, YAT&C
(Sps&YS) Dept., dated 14-05-2026, the Governor of Andhra Pradesh hereby issue
the following revised guidelines for governing such appointments, duly
superseding the guidelines issued vide G.O. fourth read above :-

This Notification shall come into force with effect from the date of issue of
this order.

## I. Guidelines

a. The Recruitment of eligible meritorious sportspersons under three percent
(3%) sports quota shall be based on the Notifications issued by the
concerned Recruiting Agency viz., Andhra Pradesh Public Service
Commission (APPSC)/Selection Board/Department concerned etc. The list
of Meritorious Sportspersons who qualify in the prescribed Recruitment
Examinations conducted by Recruiting agencies will be subject to scrutiny
by the Sports Authority of Andhra Pradesh (SAAP). After scrutiny as per the
prescribed procedure, the SAAP shall communicate the list of such
Meritorious Sportspersons organized in order of priority to the Recruiting
Agency concerned.

b. The three percent (3%) horizontal reservation in direct recruitment under
sports quota shall apply to all the Government Departments, Local Bodies,
Public Sector Undertakings (PSUs) & Uniformed Services, including the
Police, Excise and Forest Departments.

c. Criteria for deciding the eligible meritorious sportspersons: -

i. The sports disciplines mentioned at Serial No.VI of this order are the
list of Recognized Sports Disciplines eligible for the purpose of three
percent (3%) Horizontal Reservation in direct recruitment.

ii. The eligibility criteria, based on the tournament & medals, for the
Senior level competitions of sports for employment are listed at Serial
No. VII of this order.
